title: GPU: OmniPaint DeepFurniture raw-generated-before dataset
body:
GPU UUID: GPU-27ff99d6-d77d-2226-a4b5-7a11b8ef6bdd
CUDA device: cuda:0
Lock: /tmp/hermes-gpu-0.lock
Working directory: /home/krz/PycharmProjects/OmniPaint
Command: /home/krz/PycharmProjects/OmniPaint/scripts/run_deepfurniture_dataset_gpu_queue.sh
Outputs: /mnt/e/data/edit_datasets and /mnt/e/data/edit_datasets/_work/episodes/*/{generated.png,before.jpg,after.jpg,complete.json}
Log: /mnt/e/data/edit_datasets/_work/raw_generated_before_full_run.log
Model: /mnt/d/hf-cache/exports/FLUX.1-dev-convrot8
Compositing policy: raw_generated_before_v1 — image_before is raw full OmniPaint removal generation, not paste-back.
Acceptance:
1. Run the exact command above from the working directory.
2. The command itself acquires /tmp/hermes-gpu-0.lock and refuses unknown compute processes.
3. Do not launch outside the lock.
4. Do not complete this card before the command exits and these checks pass:
   - /mnt/e/data/edit_datasets/generation_report.json exists.
   - generation_report.json total equals completed counts sum.
   - /mnt/e/data/edit_datasets/_work/raw_generated_before_full_run.log records ALL DATASETS COMPLETE AND VALIDATED.
   - Spot-check at least three completed episode directories contain generated.png, before.jpg, after.jpg, mask_removal.png, complete.json with compositing_version raw_generated_before_v1.
Failure handling:
- Exit 75 means lock unavailable; comment/block, do not bypass.
- Exit 76 means unexpected GPU compute process; comment/block, do not kill it.
- Preserve the log and first failure traceback before retrying.
